fact: BCEAO launched PI-SPI on 30 September 2025, a 24/7 interoperable instant payment platform for the UEMOA, and reports 80 participants connected on 2 April 2026 (communique).
Niger is a UEMOA member state on the regional PI-SPI platform that BCEAO runs, with its institutions required to connect by 30 June 2026.
BCEAO says it set up the PI-SPI instant-payment interoperability platform, allowing account-to-account transfers between different types of accounts across the UMOA, of which Niger is a member.
BCEAO says it set up the regional payment systems STAR-UMOA, SICA-UMOA and SAGETIL-UMOA for the Union.
Airtel Money Niger SA is authorised by the BCEAO as an electronic money issuer under Décision n° 194-07-2022, per ActuNiger.
Bénin Web TV reports, from the BCEAO list, that Niger has one licensed payment institution at 31 August 2026.
BCEAO runs PI-SPI, the instant payment platform for UEMOA members including Niger, launched 30 September 2025 with 175 connected participants a year later.
Niger is a UEMOA member in the BCEAO's PI-SPI regional instant payment system, in service.
The BCEAO's list of payment institutions licensed under Instruction n°001-01-2024 shows one in Niger, iFUTUR, licensed 6 May 2025.

L'Oeil du Sahel says the BCEAO's official list, updated to 30 September 2026, records 13 participants authorised to open PI-SPI services to the public in Niger: eleven banks, Airtel Money Niger and i-FUTUR.
